rule_or_requirement: A faster pixel policy must distinguish safe fast-action windows from imminent route loss while preserving qualified finishes.
observable_information: Current four rendered frames, pixel road/HUD/obstacle features, and the frozen fast and safe actions; future TRAIN collision and visual loss only label training rows.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Train one fixed pixel/action risk classifier and freeze a threshold from TRAIN negatives; no learned-policy driving in this cycle.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 40 positive train and 10 positive validation states; validation AUC >=0.70, recall >=0.50, false-positive rate <=0.25, safe checkpoint and zero invalid actions.
control: Exact visual mode-switch ZIP SHA b0dc7a24e6ef994cee6e663ec6605f5aa088dbb9b3ce4510f90ccd16dc9d7fc4 and its unchanged runtime, paired with unchanged fast-only actor on twelve new TRAIN cells.
falsifier: Insufficient positive support, weak validation discrimination, broad false alarms, unsafe checkpoint, action drift or invalid actions.
smallest_decisive_experiment: 24 fixed driving episodes on tracks 1-3 x TRAIN seeds 5044-5047, then within-TRAIN classifier fit and held-back validation.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU profile capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no non-TRAIN labels or external action.
